ModMetaData.name: 阵营种族多样性 (Faction Race Diversity)
ModMetaData.author: yyyyy
ModMetaData.description:
Provides direct per-faction race and xenotype proportion controls for loaded humanlike factions. The two bundled mixed-peoples factions permanently use equal weights across all available humanlike races when following original rules. Curated compatibility profiles cover 18 HAR races, 82 internal/vanilla/DLC/first-party faction identifiers, and optional xenotypes from Ratkin, Kiiro, Milira, Miho, Nivarian, Wolfein, Dragonian, Moosesian, and Yuran content. Multiple installed same-race faction expansions are selected as stable per-faction PawnKind variants instead of silently overwriting one another. Existing pawns are not changed.
设置页直接显示种族比例与各 Race 的异种比例，不再使用启用复选框。百族同盟的原始规则永久为所有当前人形 Race 等权。当前内置 18 个 Race 配置显式覆盖 82 个本模组、原版/DLC 与已核对 HAR 来源派系；新增美狐族星环扩展兼容，星环军事实体可使用全部已登记 Race，安装星环扩展时其他派系也可选择美狐族及其原生异种；启用米莉拉 Gene Patch 时，瓦尔基里与派卡萨斯使用各自混血 Race、异种和通用角色。多个同 Race 阵营扩展同时启用时，会按派系稳定分配兵种变体，不再由最后加载项覆盖全部派系。Human 为 0 时，普通袭击、援军、访客、商队商人、护卫及人形商品不会因角色不完全匹配而恢复 Human。
